name: morrow-and-paw
description: Premium multipage pet shop HTML template

scripts.build: node scripts/build.cjs && node scripts/docs.cjs && node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write index.html "pages/**/*.html" documentation/*.html
scripts.format: prettier --write index.html "pages/**/*.html" documentation/*.html assets/css/*.css assets/js/*.js scripts/*.cjs tests/*.cjs
